Seven lanes offered `cited` nodes risen or added for the spot-check: six passed on every source fetched (25 of 26 sources say what their nodes claim; five read at full text via GitHub-hosted mirrors, the rest at abstract or index grade — publisher hosts are egress-blocked from this container), and genetic is PARTIAL: gen-15 attributes an SNP-heritability of ~11% to the Cai 2020 abstract, whose headline figure is 14% (SE 0.8%) against 26% — ~11% is a body-level estimate for one definition.
